summary: Two runs today. Evening: answered all 7 open owner notes from this morning's Shorts. Things now enter on their words, the source line shows once, a new check stops board videos that are mostly glows and stamps, and writers introduce people in one clause and show companies by name. Morning: Fixed the board rooms (things floated at the cast's eye level, so labels crossed faces), adopted a loudness measurement for every render, named two recurring board failures for writers, extended hook-voice-matches-frame and started ending-beats-act-and-vary.
why: Evening: The owner's feedback comes first (7 open notes). No experiment matured (all 5 wait), and experiments are at the cap of 5, so nothing new started. Morning: QA failed v-20261103-02 twice on the same board scene bug, and all three 2026-11-03 Shorts were sent back for empty payoffs, board beats over 6.5 s or 3 s with no event. Research routed loudness-in-render-json as adopt. The evaluator said extend for hook-voice-matches-frame; one experiment slot was free.

findings.title: No experiment matured
findings.detail: quiet-bed 1 of 4 long per arm; hook-voice-matches-frame extended, day 14 (on 9, off 8); title-names-the-moment 6 of 8 (~2 days); chart-gap-fill 1 of 4; ending-beats-act-and-vary 0 of 8.

findings.title: Props on screen before their words
findings.detail: v-20261103-03: coffee, jet and bank stood on screen 1.5-2.5 s before the words naming them (no enter action), so the beat opened static.

findings.title: Board actions mostly marks
findings.detail: Share of board actions that only mark a thing already there: v-20261103-03 71%, -02 64% (the owner's 'better animation' pick), -01 59%.

findings.title: Source printed repeatedly
findings.detail: v-20261103-01 printed 'Data:' from both its own Deal and Turn beats; the board printed it on every beat that said a fact.

findings.title: What performs
findings.detail: secret_of_rich 7.16x median 48 h views (n=4, 76% viewed); cinematic music 11.7x (n=6); myth hooks 0.13x (n=5, 27% viewed). No format has 3+ Shorts under the median for two weeks.

findings.title: Evaluator
findings.detail: 36 Shorts with 48 h data. hook-voice-matches-frame: extend (on 9, off 8, no clear effect). title-names-the-moment waits (6 of 8). quiet-bed and chart-gap-fill wait (1 of 4 long per arm). secret_of_rich 7.2x views, 76% viewed (n=4); cinematic music 11.7x, 69.5% viewed (n=6); myth hooks 0.13x.

findings.title: Failures, last 14 days
findings.detail: Most widespread: QA 'cut at the edge' (31 videos), captions band (18), text off the frame (17). On the 3 board Shorts of 2026-11-03: empty frames (3 of 3), board labels on faces, empty Payoff components, beats over 6.5 s.

findings.title: Formats
findings.detail: Channel median 38.6% viewed (n=34). No format with 3+ Shorts under it for two weeks (rule_change 42.2%), none retired.

findings.title: Evaluator never uses an extension
findings.detail: Once both arms have minPerArm videos, an extended experiment is abandoned at once (owner notification, evaluate.py is owner-only).

changes.title: Things arrive on their words
changes.detail: studio/travel.ts autoEnters + build.tsx: a thing first acted on 0.6 s or more into a beat flies in just before that action (no camera push for it). Stills on v-20261103-03: the jar flies in on 'taxed'; layout gate clean.

changes.title: Source line once a video
changes.detail: studio/source.ts showsSource: first board beat that says a fact (else the first beat of any scene); custom_problems fails own code that prints tl.sources without it.

changes.title: Mark cap craft check
changes.detail: renderer/craft.py mark_problems: at most 65% of a board video's actions may be marks; in render and lint.

changes.title: Writer rules for real people and companies
changes.detail: writer.md, checklist.md, short_story README: one-clause introduction (figures only as sourced facts), companies by name on a person panel or label, never pun objects.

changes.title: Board rooms: things over the heads, labels off faces
changes.detail: Rooms in a Short float things at 0.27 of the frame (was 0.2, eye level); a label over an actor goes above its thing. Stills before/after on v-20261103-02, gates clean.

changes.title: Loudness in render.json
changes.detail: Integrated LUFS (BS.1770, equal to ffmpeg's ebur128) and music-under-voice dB in the timeline, render.json and manifest; render warnings outside -16..-13 LUFS or under 18 dB in a Short.

changes.title: Recurring board failures named
changes.detail: generator/failures.py groups 'board beat over 6.5 s' and '3 s with no event'; checklist lines for both, board-room placement and Turn bar labels.

changes.title: Started ending-beats-act-and-vary
changes.detail: Prompt-only, Shorts, pacing: Turn and Payoff beats get 2-3 actions on their words and an ending camera unlike the last video's. 8 per arm, 28 days.
